summary.one_liner: Suricata is a network IDS, IPS and NSM engine developed by the OISF and its community.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short overview and contributing guide rather than a full feature description. It introduces Suricata as a network intrusion detection system (IDS), intrusion prevention system (IPS), and network security monitoring (NSM) engine. It links to resources including a home page, bug tracker, user guide, dev guide, installation guide, and user support forum. The bulk of the text explains the contribution process and the project's QA pipeline, which covers build tests, static and runtime analysis, fuzzing, and traffic replay tests. It also includes FAQ answers on pull request acceptance and a contributor license agreement requirement. It does not describe installation steps, configuration, or detection rules in the text provided.
use_cases: contributing to an open source IDS project
notable: Operates as both IDS and IPS, plus network security monitoring
Heavy QA process including fuzzing, sanitizers, and traffic replay tests
Governed by the Open Information Security Foundation (OISF)
Requires a contributor license agreement for contributions
caveats: README does not include installation or run instructions; see the linked Installation Guide
Contributions go through a lengthy multi-stage QA process with private QA runs
Contributors must sign a contributor license agreement
